name: r5 monthly system — 70/30 trend-ballast
selected: 2026-09-01 (declared); 2026-09-05 (screened bundle added); 2026-09-06 (generated bundle replaced it); 2026-09-11 (the clean nominal line replaces the split-leak bundle: features [], price_basis nominal, delist_labels last_print)
provenance: Owner-declared champion after the 4-week rebuild campaign (AGENTS.md 9h and ledger r4w_*/r5pkg_* entries); supersedes ext-t20 weekly champion. Rebuilt 2026-09-09..11 after the split-leak audit (reports/nominal_basis_registration.md, reports/delisting_honest_verdict.md): the closeadj-basis level features and the split-restated SF1 per-share fields carried future splits, and the 2026-09-06 generated bundle was built on them (the leaky champion failed ops/leak_audit.py at retention 0.49). The champion is now the clean line — the panel's f_ columns on the nominal basis, no bundle — at the standing strategy settings. Record, K=16, selection.simulate on the live ledger rules (fills at the next open, 5 bp a side), every window ending 2024-07-19 exclusive: on the delisting-honest world (data/sharadar_world2000_nominal_dl, the live rules: last-print labels, traded-within-7-days universe; ledger nominal_clean_dl_k16) 2006-2015 $229 (+8.6%/yr, SR 0.46, DD 59%) | 2016-2024 $449 (+19.1%/yr, SR 0.80, DD 42%) | pre-holdout 2006-2024 $1,028 (+13.4%/yr, SR 0.62, DD 59%) vs SPY $197 / $316 / $621 (+7.0 / +14.3 / +10.3%/yr; SR 0.46 / 0.87 / 0.64; DD 55 / 32 / 55%); on the standing nominal world (labels dropped at a delisting; ledger nominal_clean_k16) $262 / $560 / $1,468. The two worlds' ensembles agree at Spearman 0.915 (seed-halves of one walk: 0.72); the difference is path noise: disjoint K=4 draws on 2016-2024 read $484-$676 (honest) and $481-$706 (standing), all above SPY, and 2006-2015 draws straddle SPY in both worlds — a 6-name book's terminal wealth carries a ~+/-30% band. Leak audit (ops/leak_audit.py, shifted-feature retention per segment) PASS on both segments. 95% CI (reports/clean_line_confidence.md; ledger nominal_clean_dl_ci95): excess CAGR vs SPY 2016-2024 point +4.2%/yr, seed-only +3.4..+8.5, history bootstrap -5.1..+14.2, nested -3.5..+16.3; pre-holdout point +2.8%/yr, nested -2.4..+10.6; paired weekly t 0.8 / 0.8; ~90% of resampled histories beat SPY. Contaminated-basis history for scale only (git history of this file, ledger champion_r5_7030_cap2_* and openfe_arm_v3_*): the old champion read $4,256 / $900 / $473 on the same spans — roughly half of its 2016-2024 SPY-relative edge was the split leak, the rest is the clean line above. 2024-07-19+ holdout deliberately unspent.

model.summary: simple-DT: depth-3 gbtree, untuned by design (config search measured as noise)

horizon.label: label_4w
horizon.rationale: feature probe + population exams: month-ahead signal real (t>2), week-ahead dead since ~2004

training_window_rationale: style-cycle whipsaw protection; directionally better in both whipsaw eras, never worse; robustness pick within noise band

ensemble.k_copies_note: 16 since 2026-09-07 (4 from 2026-08-20): four disjoint K=4 draws of the then-champion graded $2,218-$3,498 over 2006-2024 and K=16 $4,256 (contaminated basis), so a K=4 record was one draw's luck on top of the model; the record is always the K=16 walk, with the K=4 draws quoted as the path band (clean line 2016-2024: $484-$676 honest, $481-$706 standing). selection.K_COPIES is pinned to this value by tests/test_r5.py
ensemble.method: WeekBootstrapEstimator: copy c = random_state c + whole-week bootstrap seeded by c; predictions averaged (replication.py)

strategy.weight: equal, re-leveled weekly (drift-threshold in live trading)
strategy.stop_action: none — audited 2026-09-01: stop measured mildly negative on dollars in the final configuration (as deployed, 2026-09-03: off $1,553 vs -25% $1,499, SR 0.72 vs 0.73, DD 62% vs 60%; close basis, fixed join: $1,644 vs $1,533, identical DD; before the rank-date fix, without the cap, $1,383 vs $1,296); removed for simplicity
strategy.sector_cap_note: max 2 of 6 per sector; blocked slots go to next-ranked name from another sector (adopted 2026-09-01: +0.9%/yr and better SR in every window on the champion, no DD effect; re-graded on the fixed join +0.3 to +1.9%/yr per window, +1.2%/yr and SR 0.67 -> 0.72 over 2006-2024; as deployed (2026-09-03) +1.1%/yr and SR 0.67 -> 0.72 over 2006-2024, per window +2.1 / +0.5 / -0.1%/yr for 2006-12 / 2013-24 / 2021-24 with SR up or level in each)
strategy.settings_note: Standing settings kept at the 2026-09-11 switch (owner: do not scrap the champion). The cascade re-run on the clean nominal line's own 2006-2015 record reads book 6 / 60-40 / no stop / cap 2 on the delisting-honest world and book 3 / half-gate / no stop / cap 2 on the standing world — floor and book move within the path band between worlds; re-deciding them is a registered research item, not a quiet override. The stop_action and sector_cap_note figures below are contaminated-basis history, kept for the reasoning.

ballast.ballast_asset: SPY, switched to IEF per trend state
ballast.trend_rule: one third of ballast to IEF per breached SPY trailing MA (30/40/52 weeks), evaluated weekly, point-in-time

panel: data/sharadar_world2000_nominal_dl/panel_sf.parquet (nominal basis, delisting-honest labels; price/volume + Sharadar fundamentals f_sf_* + insiders f_sfi_*; the screen's x_ candidates and any g_ columns ride along unused). Live: build_world_panel under config.yaml.
features_note: No bundle. The model's matrix is feature_cols (the panel's f_ columns: features/panel.py plus features/sharadar_fundamentals.py), research and live alike (walk.extra_features = []; r5.SPEC['features'] = features/bundle.py FEATURES = []). History: the screened ideas bundle (adopted 2026-09-05, asterisk: ideas written from the whole 2006-2024 record) and the generated bundle of 40 (adopted 2026-09-06, selected on 2006-2015 alone) were both built on split-leaky raw inputs and retired 2026-09-11; their nominal-basis replacement, screened under the same rule on 2006-2015 (ops/nominal_program.py screen), failed admission against the clean line at the cascade's own book (5.93 vs 8.14 %/yr, ledger nominal_program_verdict) and 2016-2024 read $522 vs the clean $560. A bundle re-enters only by passing the gate on 2006-2015 and the owner's go; the plumbing (generated.add_generated on bundle.FORMULAS) stays.

retune_policy.cadence: never on a calendar (nested experiment); structural triggers only
triggers: new data source / feature family passes the gate

honest_expectation: a few %/yr over SPY in expectation (2016-2024 excess CAGR +4.2%/yr, 95% nested CI -3.5..+16.3; 2006-2024 +2.8%/yr, -2.4..+10.6), a band that includes no edge, 40-60% drawdowns along the way; edge era-concentrated (2013-2020; index-matching in whipsaw/megacap regimes); pre-holdout numbers carry design-iteration shine; sizing should assume SPY-like outcomes in adverse regimes

selection_procedure.note: Mechanical cascade, run in this order on the selection window only; validated by the nested test (nested3_v1, 2026-09-04: select on every week of 2006-2015, grade 2016-2024; nested3_v2 re-ran it with the feature screen under rule v3.1, 2026-09-05; nested2_v1 was its sampled predecessor). Model config is NOT searched (simple-DT fixed; tuning measured as noise). Run programmatically: `stocks-ml select --sel-start A --sel-end B [--eval-start C --eval-end D] [--screen]` (stages cached & resumable under data/experiments/).

steps.metric: cost-adjusted compounded return of the top-6 book (full population of the selection window)
top-6 edge vs random basket, paired on the weeks every window's population walk has (every week of the selection window since v3); all windows fully formed

steps.menu: a candidate bundle over the nominal raw inputs (ops/nominal_program.py screen: generated formulas, or the x_ candidates of features/candidates.py)
steps.metric: screened on 2006-2015 alone; admitted iff the top-book cost-adjusted compounded return is higher with it than without at the cascade's own book (the paired HAC t reported, not the rule); every candidate passes ops/leak_audit.py per segment. No bundle is admitted as of 2026-09-11 (nominal screen 5.93 vs clean 8.14 %/yr)

selection_procedure.metric_convention: engine choices (horizon, window, book) by cost-adjusted compounded return; risk layers (floor, stop, cap) by Sharpe — owner-ratified 2026-09-01, 'for now'; earlier campaigns ranked by pre-tax earnings
selection_procedure.measured_selection_inflation: champion vs the nested honest-procedure pick on 2016-2024 (contaminated basis, 2026-09-04/05): clean $590 vs v3's $521, +1.9%/yr on dollars, ~0 on Sharpe. On the clean nominal line the cascade's 2006-2015 argmax differs from the standing settings on book and floor (strategy.settings_note); a nested re-measurement on the nominal world is a registered research item
selection_procedure.constraints: No layer reads a sample (v3, 2026-09-04), and no layer reads a rank week whose forward label ends after the window (`selection.label_end`: 35 days for 4w, 14 for 1w; 2026-09-05) — at a window ending at the holdout's edge those weeks would be graded on holdout prices. Selection on 2006-2015 only; 2016-01 -> 2024-07-12 is the one out-of-sample look, read once per registered candidate; the holdout never feeds selection. Every candidate passes ops/leak_audit.py on both segments before it is believed (the split leak, 2026-09-09). A bundle the screen admits is graded as a separate line beside the clean line, never in place of it; none is admitted as of 2026-09-11.

price_basis_note: config.yaml price_basis (Config.price_basis; env STOCKS_ML_PRICE_BASIS for research drivers): level features from closeunadj (what the tape showed) and the SF1 per-share ratios over the split-only adjusted close; returns and labels stay on closeadj. Adopted 2026-09-11 with the clean line. The live job's prices frame carries closeunadj/close_split from refresh_sharadar (prices_from_sep); build_world_panel refuses a nominal build without them.
delist_labels_note: config.yaml delist_labels (Config.delist_labels; env STOCKS_ML_DELIST_LABELS): a name whose series ends inside the label window grades to its final print — the live ledger's exit — instead of losing its label; the backtest universe uses live's traded-within-7-days rule (r5.rank_members). Adopted 2026-09-11 on the delisting-honest verdict (reports/delisting_honest_verdict.md): same strategy within the path band, matches what the Saturday job does with a delisting.
